## page_traffic

Daily traffic for the CanadaLogin GA4 property, broken down by page.

Each row represents one day of traffic to a single page, identified by both
its title and its path.

`Keywords`: Google Analytics, GA4, page views, traffic, page title, page path

### Provenance

Pulled daily from the GA4 Data API (`runReport`) for the CanadaLogin property,
via the same Lambda and pipeline as
[`property_traffic`](google_analytics.qmd#property_traffic).

* **Updated**: Daily, at 07:00 ET
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Colin Douglas](mailto:colin.douglas@cds-snc.ca)
* **Location**: `s3://<transformed-bucket>/google_analytics/page_traffic/`

### Fields

One row per `date` per `pagetitle` per `pagepath`.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| date | string | The reporting day, as a partition key (for example, "2026-07-23") |
| pagetitle | string | The page's `<title>` at the time of the visit |
| pagepath | string | The page's URL path |
| sessions | bigint | Number of sessions that included this page on this day |
| activeusers | bigint | Number of distinct active users who viewed this page on this day |
| screenpageviews | bigint | Number of times this page was viewed on this day |

### Notes

**Keep both `pagetitle` and `pagepath` in mind when joining or filtering.**
Title alone is an unstable key: a page retitled in a release starts a fresh
row with no link to its history (this has happened repeatedly to CanadaLogin's
sign-in and sign-up pages - see the
[task success rate](../cookbook/google_analytics.qmd#task-success-rate)
metric for the concrete impact). Path alone is unreadable in a report. Prefer
`pagepath` for anything that needs to survive a copy or title change.

**`activeusers` does not sum across pages.** GA4 de-duplicates active users
*within* a row's dimension combination, so a user who visited three pages in a
day appears in all three rows. Summing `activeusers` across pages, or across
this table and [`property_traffic`](google_analytics.qmd#property_traffic),
overcounts. `sessions` and `screenpageviews` are safe to sum; see the
[`property_traffic`](google_analytics.qmd#property_traffic) integrity-check
note.

`screenpageviews` exposes per-step retries on a form page (views greater than
1 on a single page in a day is a friction signal invisible in a funnel's
pass/fail step counts).
